investment.heroSubtitle: Tangible real estate assets with strong use value, driven by structural demand.
investment.conceptP1: I-CA.RE acquires undervalued urban ground floors (50 to 300 sqm) and transforms them into next-generation care and wellbeing spaces.
investment.conceptP2: Each asset ranges from 50 to 300 sqm, with an optimised common-area ratio that enhances circulation and shared use. Private offices, typically 11 to 15 sqm, can be custom-designed to meet the specific needs of each professional. The granular multi-tenant structure structurally reduces vacancy risk.
investment.executionModelDesc: A responsible, long-term stewardship approach founded on utility, asset quality and sustainable management.
investment.pillar1Desc: Care and wellbeing spaces, in the heart of communities, meeting structural demand. Practitioner stability and continuity of care.
investment.pillar2Desc: Rigorous location selection, full renovation, regulatory compliance and energy performance.
investment.pillar3Desc: Demanding operations, preventive maintenance, practitioner community facilitation and continuous improvement of spaces.
investment.forInvestorsP1: I-CA.RE is a family-backed private real estate company that structures care and wellbeing operations with an entrepreneurial model. The investor contributes capital; I-CA.RE contributes the full operational capability: development, engineering, construction, leasing and asset stewardship.

items.quote: I now practise within an I-CA.RE space and have found a setting that is both professional and deeply human. The fit-out is of high quality: renovation, acoustics, comfort, and a soothing atmosphere that genuinely supports the therapeutic alliance. The space allows me to welcome patients in the right conditions, with a real sense of confidentiality and safety. Day to day, the environment is respectful and warm, which has a concrete positive impact on my practice and on the quality of welcome I can offer.

approach.heroSubtitle: Vision, method and commitment in service of care and wellbeing across communities.
approach.founderIntro: I-CA.RE is led by a complementary, deeply committed duo.
approach.founderJazmin: With a background in humanistic psychotherapy, Jazmin brings sensitivity, a strong design aesthetic, and a high standard for the quality of welcome.
approach.founderNicolas: Nicolas brings more than ten years of experience in real estate, the transformation of spaces, and project delivery.
approach.founderAmbition: Their ambition: to create high-quality, comfortable and calming places that support human care.
approach.desertTitle: A broad, structural and durable market
approach.desertSubtitle: A deep sector, driven by evolving lifestyles and the need for premises suited to receiving the public.
approach.stat1Label: psychologists in France (active professionals as of 1 January 2024)
approach.stat2Label: rehabilitation professionals (dieticians, occupational therapists, psychomotor therapists, speech therapists, orthoptists…), excluding physiotherapists and podiatrists
approach.stat3Label: wellbeing services market (spaces and services) in France
approach.desertP1: The sector is deep: multiple professions, multiple uses, and the real bottleneck is often adapted premises for receiving the public — privacy, acoustic comfort, quality of welcome.
approach.desertP2: I-CA.RE provides a concrete answer: we identify high-potential buildings, transform them into modern care and wellbeing spaces, and settle practitioners in optimal conditions.

values.responsibilityDesc: We embrace our role in improving access to care for all.
values.impactDesc: Every project strengthens the care fabric of a neighbourhood, a city.
values.careDesc: Towards practitioners, patients, neighbours and our partners.
values.excellenceDesc: Architectural and technical quality in service of care.

approach.methodDesc: Every I-CA.RE project follows a proven methodology that guarantees quality delivery and operational success. From sourcing to management, we control the entire value chain.

steps.s1Desc: We identify areas of tension and buildings with high transformation potential.
steps.s2Desc: We carry out an in-depth study of the building and its environment to validate the project's potential.
steps.s3Desc: Our architectural partners (Rivage IC and IDNéa) design spaces optimised for care and wellbeing.
steps.s4Desc: Our partner Inside BAT manages the refurbishment works with rigour and respect for deadlines.
steps.s5Desc: We recruit care, allied health and wellbeing practitioners and assemble a balanced multidisciplinary team.
steps.s6Desc: We support opening and provide long-term technical and tenancy management.

approach.teamSubtitle: Complementary expertise serving a shared mission.
approach.collectivitesDesc:
The care, allied health and wellbeing sector is broad and long-term. Yet premises supply often lags behind: many professionals work in spaces originally designed for residential use, not for receiving the public (privacy, acoustics, professional identity, welcome).

I-CA.RE addresses this by requalifying undervalued ground floors and urban centralities into spaces genuinely designed for these practices.

collectivitesBenefits.heritageDesc: Give new life to underused or degraded buildings through quality refurbishment.
collectivitesBenefits.employmentDesc: Create local jobs and enhance the appeal of your area for residents and businesses.
collectivitesBenefits.securityDesc: Benefit from a solid operator committed to long-term management and community engagement.

approach.caseStudyTitle: Pey Berland: An Asset in the Heart of Bordeaux
approach.caseStudyContextDesc: In the historic centre of Bordeaux, at the foot of the Pey Berland cathedral, a ground-floor unit to be requalified as a care space.
approach.caseStudySolutionDesc: Full refurbishment into 5 offices and a waiting room across 90 sqm. The asset now hosts 8 practitioners — psychologists, psychotherapist and sophrologists.
